digest.component_or_area: Ticket state schema and write surfaces
propositions: Add tri-state bridge_project field to ticket state schema, seeded from CREATE event data and projected by reducer, with absent meaning legacy, empty string meaning never sync, and a key meaning sync to that project
Add repos field as a list of strings to ticket state schema, seeded from CREATE event and projected by reducer, freely editable without binding constraints
Implement create-time arguments --bridge-project and --repos on all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) that populate CREATE event data and pass through to ticket state

Implement edit-time --bridge-project and --repos flags on the edit surface with a promote-only guard that refuses bridge_project changes on tickets already holding a binding while allowing unbound tickets to be set
Ensure the three ticket state fields (absent, explicitly empty, set) for bridge_project are distinguishable after a full reducer replay
Verify backward compatibility: tickets created before this change replay to identical state except for the new absent keys
